metadata.name: NIGHT
metadata.description: NIGHT is Midnight’s utility token whose main function is to generate DUST, the resource used to execute transactions on the Midnight network. It is intended that NIGHT will also be used for block production rewards, ecosystem growth incentives, and on-chain governance in relation to the Midnight network. One unit of NIGHT is further divided into one million subunits called STARs.

metadata.name: USDCx
metadata.description: USDCx is a dollar-denominated stablecoin issued on Cardano as a Cardano Native Asset (CNA). The underlying USDC is independently backed by Circle's dollar reserves.
